scope: Static review of one-run parent wrapper and first indexed uniform registration; no dispatch.
verified_source_contracts: Exactly one indexed run ID selected and registration path constrained to a direct child run directory.
Index, parent gates, registration, external gate pins, and installed dependency inventory are hash checked before lease/marker writes.
Output, attempt claim, launch marker, dispatch, and parent receipt paths must be unspent before dispatch.
Source acceptance remains separate from canonical launch approval in the worker envelope.
Parent execution and raw observer exit receipt fields satisfy r2 audit consumer expectations.
Wrapper starts one observer process, waits/reaps it, writes raw exit, and contains no retry, next-arm, automatic audit, or promotion path.
limits: Parent gates document was not consumed; its final contents and live state were not qualified by this review.
External parent must pin exact wrapper, index, selected registration, source/runtime, calibration, dependency inventory, and accepted reviews.
Runtime release parity and actual native/MPS qualification remain separate parent gates.
No state/lease or marker writes, child launch, native/Torch/MPS calls, or checkpoint loads were performed.
